text: 2026-09-22 review: the facade accepts two checked source kinds, both mapped under the same profiles and outputs: (a) a text source (StoryModel via StorySourceView / G1 TextSource), and (b) a timed annotation source (the TimedSegment contract, migrated out of embed-bench by the preparation bead; the same contract carries video-derived packages). Record the pipeline build edges (align, corpusIntake, embedOnnx channel adapter) with an ADR line. Environment variables of the form STORYMODEL4S_* must not reach the facade (AC1).
